laws: Exact source object required; site-root-only locators are insufficient when a specific object exists.
Publication or source date must be recorded when known; null requires an explicit status or reason.
Source lineage must be explicit so mirrors, reviews, and reruns do not masquerade as independent corroboration.
independent_corroboration_count counts additional independent source lineages beyond the primary source; same-lineage reviews or reruns do not increment it.
Community or editorial evidence may establish vocabulary usage or strategic framing but cannot override pinned Oracle or Comprehensive Rules mechanics.
Repository measurements are evidence about measured system behavior, never relevance ground truth.
A benchmark row may link multiple claims; every claim id must resolve exactly once.
Candidate S16B output may never corroborate its own benchmark.
